description: A `<script>` inside a `<pre>` raw body in a component definition is E-SCRIPT-001 (S462 review: the component re-parse never scanned the raw body; the script ran).
rationale: §4.17 companion considerations: "`<script>` and `<style>` are NOT raw-content in scrml because scrml does not admit those elements at all." S462 amendment: the element is rejected with the same codes at EVERY position markup is parsed or built; inside a raw-content body the rule is fail-closed — any `<script` / `<style` start-tag text, wherever it sits in the body.
